Hi Alex,

Thank you for your interest and for submitting your application. After careful review of your resume and portfolio, we have decided not to move forward with your candidacy at this time. 

We wish you the best of luck in your job search and future career endeavors.

Best regards,
Recruiting Team
args.subject: Update regarding your application

args.rationale: Candidate lacks relevant professional experience and technical skills for the role. Portfolio consists of a basic WordPress blog. Low GPA and general studies degree.

args.body:
Dear Alex,

Thank you for your interest in our open positions and for taking the time to apply. After careful review of your application and portfolio, we have decided to move forward with other candidates whose qualifications more closely align with our current needs.

We wish you the best of luck in your job search and future professional endeavors.

Sincerely,
Recruiting Team
